verdict.rationale: Ollama documents its own REST API server with local base URLs that clients can call, so it does run as a server. Nothing in the pack shows how to expose it on the local network (for example, binding to a non-localhost interface) or confirms that other devices can reach it. A community comment refers to 'a remote Ollama instance', which implies remote access is possible, but it is a complaint that the desktop app cannot connect to one, not documentation. Missing for 10: documented LAN/host binding configuration, guidance on access from other devices, network security/auth controls, hands-on corroboration of cross-device access.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can serve models over my local network for access from other devices
